description: Save text to a plain text file (.txt, UTF-8): the stories of the given frames, or every story in the document, separated by blank lines (File > Export > Text Format)

filePath.description: Absolute .txt path; an existing file is replaced

target.description: Text frames to work on (groups are searched for them). Default: every story in the document

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: export_text
title: Export Text
